wish: someone should make an alarm that adds more instruments to a song each minute you don't dismiss it
spec:
Set a wake time; at that time a looping song starts with one instrument and adds a layer (bass, kick, hi-hat, pad, bells) every minute until dismissed.
Pick a time, tap set alarm, leave the page open with sound on; tap hear it (fast) to preview one layer per second.
It does not ring if the page is closed or the phone is locked, and it makes no network requests.
notes: Browser alarms only sound while the page stays open and the screen is on; no way around that offline.
